\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{graphs,quotes}

\begin{document}
\tikz
  \graph[
    grow right=1.5cm,
    nodes={draw,circle,minimum size=6mm},
    edges={thick}
  ] {
    a ->[red, "start"] b --["middle"'] c ->[blue,bend left, "return"] a;
  };
